technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with strong ADX trend exist, but severe bearish confluence (price below all major MAs, below cloud, three black crows, negative volume signals) and lack of bullish confirmation make this a high-risk setup unsuitable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: WM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk 62 days out.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional selling signals and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 62 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with strong ADX trend and contrarian fear sentiment (22/100) create a classic reversal setup, and price is near support (131.64) offering defined risk.
